principles: Motion supports orientation, hierarchy, and state change.
Primary reveal language is opacity + blur + translateY.
Primary surface-swap language is opacity + blur + scale.
Continuous loops are allowed only for top-card hover feedback.
Reduced-motion fallback is required for reveal, top-card swap, lightbox choreography, and home glass/preview motion.

motion: Top card swaps through AnimatedTopCard.
Home heading and case list use sequenced page reveal.

Active case glass position uses velocity-preserving physics with mass 0.9: smoothstep remains for stiffness 320..460 and post-target tail time-warp 1x..2x, while damping ratio 0.80..0.62 uses a separate normalized exponential ease-out measured in actual item steps with scale 4.5. Only post-target residual offsets use a 16px exponential soft knee toward an asymptotic 28px cap; pre-target motion and all distance curves remain unchanged; size morph uses 220/22/1.0.

Pointer shift targets ±16px/±10px through a 300/24/0.75 spring with power 1.4; active text follows 25% over 420ms expressive easing, outgoing text returns explicitly over 600ms standard easing, re-entry hands the current transform back to CSS without a jump, the glass uses 1400px perspective, and the shared close delay remains 380ms.
Hover preview is a fine-pointer desktop enhancement and swaps media with blur/opacity/scale transitions; reduced motion uses opacity only.

motion: Case items reveal with the shared page-reveal language.
Active case text follows 25% of pointer shift over 420ms expressive easing; outgoing text returns through WAAPI over 600ms standard easing, and re-entry preserves its current visual transform.

Glass position preserves spring velocity: smoothstep maps distance to stiffness 320..460 and post-target tail time 1x..2x, while damping ratio 0.80..0.62 follows a separate normalized exponential curve with scale 4.5 actual item steps. Post-target residual offsets alone use a continuous 16px soft knee toward an asymptotic 28px cap, and its derivative also scales inherited velocity; size uses a 220/22/1.0 lightweight morph spring.
Glass follows pointer targets ±16px/±10px with restrained transform depth and 1400px perspective.
Reduced motion makes geometry instant and disables pointer and text transforms.
